Theorem
[Harnack's inequality] 1. ch6:6.4-thm-5\group Maximum Principles Assume $u \geq 0$ is a $C^2$ solution of \[ Lu = 0 \quad \text{in } U, \] and suppose $V \subset \subset U$ is connected. Then there exists a constant $C$ such that \[ (18) \qquad \sup _V u \leq C\inf _V u. \] The constant $C$ depends only on $V$ and the coefficients of $L$. For bounded measurable coefficient variants, see \cite{GilbargTrudinger1983}.
